Definition: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
BiblicalUsage: ʼEsher is happiness — the blessedness of the man who walks in God's way. Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the ungodly; blessed is the man whose transgression is forgiven; blessed is every one that feareth the LORD. It is the word for the happiness that comes from being right with God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼesher is the Bible's definition of happiness: not luck, not wealth, but being in the place God blesses. I hold that the first psalm has it right — happiness is a path, and the path is God's way.
